# Gani Properties

> Property provider in Bangalore/Ballari, Karnataka, offering verified residential plots, commercial spaces, farmland, and agricultural lands, plus a construction franchise program ("Approval to Key").

Gani Properties operates primarily in Kattigenahalli, Yelahanka, Hunasamaranahalli, and Chikkaballapur, with additional developer and franchise partnerships across Karnataka. Listings, pricing, and availability change frequently — always confirm current details against the live pages below rather than caching them.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://ourganiproperties.com/): Company overview, featured properties, and franchise highlights.
- [Properties](https://ourganiproperties.com/properties): Full property catalogue with filters by type, city, and status.
- [Developers](https://ourganiproperties.com/developers): Information for real estate developers and partners.
- [Franchise](https://ourganiproperties.com/franchise): Construction franchise models, investment tiers, and ROI.
- [Careers](https://ourganiproperties.com/careers): Current job openings and how to apply.
- [About](https://ourganiproperties.com/about): Company background and management team.
- [Contact](https://ourganiproperties.com/contact): Office location, phone, and enquiry form.

## Notes

- `/dashboard` is an authenticated admin panel — not public content and should not be crawled or indexed.
